_comment: IRL2FA power model: datasheet constants only. Currents at 3.0 V, 25 C; 'typ' from datasheet typicals, 'worst' from maxima or a stated conservative bound. How long each part is on comes from the emulated firmware, hardware/power/measured.json (firmware/renode/power.robot). Used by hardware/power/power.py, which also generates the browser simulator's sim/web/power-model.js. SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-S-2.0

battery._usable_note: Renata CR2450N rates 540 mAh to 2.0 V at 7.5 kohm; pulsed e-paper loads and cold reduce it, so usable capacity is taken as the 540 mAh rating, not the 620 mAh nominal.

mcu_stop2.source: STM32U083 DS14548: Stop 2 without RTC 695 nA @ 1.8 V; scaled to 3 V

rtc_rv3032.source: RV-3032-C7 datasheet: 160 nA typ / 210 nA max @ 3 V

epd_switch_off.source: AO3401A IDSS 1 uA max at -30 V; nA at 3 V

run_mA.source: STM32U083 at 16 MHz HSI16, range 1, code from flash: 52 uA/MHz headline (DS14548 p.1, 1.8 V, range 2) is 0.83 mA; 1.2 mA allows for range 1, 3 V and HSI16. Not yet checked against the DS14548 Run-mode table.

sleep_mA.source: Sleep mode (WFI) at 16 MHz with HSI16 and SysTick running: estimate, about 30 % of Run as on other Cortex-M0+ STM32s. Not yet checked against the DS14548 Sleep-mode table.

mcu._note: Renode runs the core at 16 MIPS, so run time = instructions executed / 16e6: one cycle per instruction. A real Cortex-M0+ takes 1-3 cycles for loads, stores and branches, so the measured run time is a lower bound; the 'worst' current covers some of it.

refresh_mA.source: GDEY0213B74 typical operating current 3.5 mA @ 3 V (during a refresh)

logic_mA.source: SSD1680 powered with the analog block off (reset, register and RAM writes): assumption, no datasheet figure for this state

epd._refresh_source: GDEY0213B74: full refresh 3 s, partial 0.42 s @ 25 C. The emulated SSD1680 holds BUSY this long, so these also set the measured BUSY time.
epd._spi_note: SPI1 at fPCLK/2 = 8 MHz (hal_stm32u0.c). The emulated SPI is instantaneous, so the wire time, bytes x 8 / 8 MHz, is added as run time: the core polls TXE/RXNE through every byte.

bus_mA.source: two 4.7 kohm pull-ups at 3 V (0.64 mA each when pulled low), low about a quarter of the bit time on average; worst: half

led_mA.source: VSMB2948SL through 100 ohm and AO3400A: 18 mA at 3 V; hardware/spice/ir_led.cir limits it to 25 mA on a fresh cell

rx_mA.source: VEMT2523SLX01 emitter follower into 10 kohm: photocurrent only, at most 3 V / 10 kohm = 0.3 mA when lit; dark current is nA
